title: Static
content:
Type: STAT
Papyrus: Static Script Statics are the base forms of simple references that are used to construct detailed environments, such as ridges, rock formations, and asphalt roads. They cannot have scripts attached and have no special functionality; they are "static" rather than dynamic.
